title: The Death and Resurrection of Jesus

sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another.
Read

Another time Jesus taught, “The miracles that I do in my Father’s name speak for Me. I know my sheep and they follow Me. I give them eternal life and will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.” These miracles and teachings prove that Jesus is God!

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

When Jesus claimed to be God, the teachers of the law became angry. They decided to kill Him. Jesus is the only person who has ever lived without sin and therefore did not deserve death. God’s plan was that Jesus’ death would be the last sacrifice for the sins of the world. Jesus who was sinless died to pay for our sins! The story does not end there. After three days God raised Jesus back to life! This proved the power of God was greater than the power of sin and death.

The Bible tells us that if we confess our sins to God and believe that Jesus’ sacrifice paid for our sins, we can be forgiven. When our sins are forgiven, then our relationship with God our Creator is restored, just as it was before Adam and Eve sinned. And this story is from the word of God.
Read
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Matthew 27:57 to 28:10
Read

These verses teach us that God's grace took our place. Jesus was innocent, but he suffered death for our sins on the cross. He paid the debt we could never pay. The resurrection proves that His sacrifice was accepted. It offers us peace with God now, and hope for our future. God's love for us is beyond anything we could ever imagine! He is the living God who loves us. We can trust him completely.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Do

Do you understand why Jesus died and rose again? The sacrifice of Jesus is God’s only path for the forgiveness of sin. If you have turned from sin and trusted in Jesus, your sins are forgiven! Thank him for this gift and listen to the next lesson.
Ask
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
